subject: Last-minute clincher: one-time credit + 30d trial extension
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paymodo.io>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick idea to close this quarter — credit + extension

Sanjay —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. PayModo’s ingest patterns and bursty inference for enrichment look like a great fit for Redwood Dedicated. I know you’re aiming to finalize a POC this quarter so wanted to propose a short, pragmatic close incentive to get you across the line.

Proposal (one-time):
- $6,000 account credit applied to first month consumption (to reduce early production friction)
- 30-day free trial extension for the two initial models we tested

I can move fast but need a quick internal approval. If you can verbalize acceptance today I’ll loop in Renewals and Legal to turn this into a one-page amendment. Two quick asks for your side:
1) Confirm the billing entity (PayModo, Inc.) and billing contact
2) Confirm there are no outstanding legal SSO/KMS requirements beyond the SOC2 docs we shared

If that sounds good I’ll ping leadership for a one-off credit approval and come back with a signed note.

—Marcus

Marcus —

Appreciate the follow-up and the offer. Two clarifications before we proceed:
- Is the $6k credit refundable or strictly a consumption credit? We prefer credits applied to usage, not cashbacks.
- Can you confirm SLAs for the Dedicated pool during onboarding? Our ops lead will want a short note we can include in our runbook.

Billing entity: PayModo, Inc.
Billing contact: Clara Jensen <clara.j@paymodo.io>

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paymodo.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Request: one-time $6k credit + 30d extension for PayModo (DEAL-2026-PM-42)

Grace / Monica —

Heads-up: PayModo (high-growth fintech prospect) is asking for a small close incentive to convert their POC to a pilot this quarter. Details below pulled from the thread with Sanjay (cc’d).

Summary:
- Ask: $6,000 consumption credit (applied to first billing cycle) + 30-day trial extension for initial test models
- Rationale: PayModo has bursty inference demand; a credit reduces friction on early spend and improves chance of expansion. Win probability jumps to ~65% with this incentive.
- Risk: One-off credit, non-refundable, applied to usage only; no precedent of revenue reversal required.
- Compliance: They have signed our SOC2/DPAs; legal contact is Priya Sharma (cc’d).

Proposed guardrails:
- Credit expiry: applied only to usage within first 60 days after pilot activation
- Max claim per invoice: $6,000; any unused portion expires
- Require signature on a 1-page amendment (I’ll attach) and PO from PayModo

Attachments: MAP draft for the amendment (will attach in reply).

Can I get approval to grant this one-time credit under the guardrails above? If yes I’ll finalize the amendment and send to Priya and Clara for countersignature.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paymodo.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time $6k credit + 30d extension for PayModo (DEAL-2026-PM-42)

Marcus —

Approve the $6k credit with the guardrails you listed. Two small edits required on the amendment:
1) Add clause "credits are applied to base consumption and are not transferrable to third parties"
2) Add confirmation that Redwood’s SLA for Dedicated onboarding is XX% uptime for the first 30 days and escalation path to our SRE team (I can push a short paragraph).

Monica — please add any billing compliance notes before Marcus sends the doc. Once we have the one-pager we’ll sign-off and Marcus can route to PayModo.

—Grace
VP, Global Sales Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paymodo.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.legal@paymodo.io>, Clara Jensen <clara.j@paymodo.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: PayModo one-time credit + trial extension (next steps)

Sanjay —

Good news: Redwood has approved a one-time $6,000 consumption credit (applied to first billing) and a 30-day trial extension for the two models in your POC. Grace approved with the guardrails listed below. Attached is the amendment and the signed approval note for your records.

Key points / next steps:
- Credit: $6,000 applied against PayModo, Inc. consumption; expires 60 days after pilot activation; not refundable; not transferable
- Trial extension: 30 days; same models and endpoints as current POC configuration
- SLAs: We’ll include a 30-day Dedicated onboarding paragraph and SRE escalation details in the amendment (Grace added the language)
- Action items for PayModo: Please return the signed PO or countersigned amendment and confirm Clara Jensen as billing contact
- Internal action: Renewals will enter the credit into our billing system once we receive the signed amendment (cc Monica)

Attachments: approved_credit_note.pdf (one-page approval), MAP_PayModo_2026-11-30.docx (1-page amendment draft)

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if you want to get this done fast.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0129
